notes.title: Version 13.2 Patch
notes.content:
Heya! Here's some hotfixes for some issues with the game. Nothing too spectacular, but should be something, I hope...


- Accidental walljumps when too close to a wall has been fixed
- I-Frames with the traps has been fixed
- Possibly lag in Dreamer's Paradise fix (might be tied to discord overlay)
- Lag in Cyberspace 4's minigame fix
- Getting stuck in gaps while jumping has been fixed
- Reduced odds of dropping ability (2/7 > 1/9)
- Reduced radius of Mun Magnet a tad, not game changing, but it was a little too big (110 > 90)
- Timer no longer counts up when in dialogue
- UI alignment fix when in dialogue

notes.title: Version 13.1 Patch
notes.content:
Heya! Been a month but I'm still kicking and doing some quick changes:

- Fixed a softlock on Dreamer's Paradise's ending cutscene
- Fixed door positions in Rusted Plains
- Added a bit of variation in Isabella and Shine's attacks
- Gave Simon and Seraphina 20 more HP
- Added new music to the last cutscene

notes.title: Launch Update 13
notes.content:
Some big stuff is finally being added to tip off the game

Fixes

o Fixed Seraphina meteor
o Fixed UI for completion on files


New character added! Some of you already know who it is but I'll let you find out how to unlock them!

Buffed all main bosses hp by 10% (except Kai)
Atlas Skill damage reduced (19->15)


Misc.

+ Some design additions to the scenery
+ Audio Test added
+ Cutscene additions and changes
+ New music
+ Portrait sprites for Lubinare added
+ Voice acting sounds added

notes.title: Version 12.6 Patch
notes.content:
Some final* touches to the game to make it complete. All that's left is further bug testing, polishing and 2 extra things!

Fixes

o Fixed some crashes
o Fixed bosses being invincible for the first encounter
o Fixed an issue where the final boss insta-kills on phase 2 sometimes

Misc.

+ Some level design additions
+ New cutscenes from before are now in the gallery so every cutscene is fully watchable
+ Music changes for stages
+ Final changes and additions to the story have been made

notes.title: Version 12.5 Patch
notes.content:
Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes. Fixes.

Fixes

o Fixed numerous soft locks
o Ability blocks now react to more attack hitboxes
o Fixed Bomb's air dash angles being weird
o Fixed going through Orbistars
o Fixed Seraphina meteor
o Removed "Try to not get hit" text from 3-1's level intro
o Reduced volume for some tracks
o Fixed text size issues
o Fixed an issue where DP's final cutscene did not play properly
o Fixed issue where lives would show up when not in use
o Fixed issue where pausing at the final boss would insta-kill you
o Fixed CTRL bindings crashing on the control screen
o Fixed an issue where Tactites blew up
o Fixed Seraphina being stuck in a wall
o Fixed Lubinare being stuck in a wall
o Fixed emblems showing wrong on RP 4
o Fixed emblems showing wrong on EOR 2
o Fixed rocket flower
o Fixed an issue where charging pyro or frost for a split second would still trigger the attack when landing


Balance Changes

+ Bosses HP has been balanced (lowered and altered to better fit the pacing of the game)
+ World Bosses are more aggressive
+ Shock bounce is now 1, however, damaging enemies with a jump gives back that bounce
+ Jump height increased
+ Hint system - there are now floating hints to help you with mechanics not normally explained to you!
+ Screen transitions reset spin out limit
+ Made Shine's projectiles take slightly longer to come out
+ Stellar speed abilities (air dash, etc.) increased
+ Stellar has new attacks

CHEATS ARE ADDED!
Cheats are unlocked when completing the game (either by 100% or any%) and are just for fun stuff I added for you guys

Misc.

+ New victory theme for bosses
+ Worlds text shows "Parallel" when viewing the parallel stages
+ When reaching max gauge for your partner, the icon to use it will appear above them
+ Stellar icons added
+ Going near a minecart is enough to put you in it
+ Changed text box color
+ Background additions and edits
+ Game completion puts a sticker on your file
+ Default controls changed
+ Changed parallax scrolling
+ Added text for Edge of Reality window bar
+ New sounds for enemies and environment
+ Damage Numbers fly out in a more animated way
+ Muns hitboxes increased
+ New quest

notes.title: Version 12.3 Patch
notes.content:
Small patch because I'm an idiot:

Fixes

o Fixed the all colorfoam achievement from not working
o Fixed colorfoam UI not appearing in some places
o Fixed random flowers spawning if you 100%'d The Cyberspace
o In the intro cutscene, fixed colors on who was talking (it was only white for both Cappi and Atlas)
o Fixed error in Kai cutscene

Additions

+ Added Final Boss sprites
+ Kai moves during his boss fight

notes.title: Version 12.2 Patch
notes.content:
Doing some more small additions to make the game more complete:

Fixes

o Fixed cutscene volumes
o Fixed an issue where redoing an attempt of bosses in Cyberspace and Edge of Reality would not put you in the ability room first

Additions

+ More cutscenes and added more to some cutscenes
+ New added music for levels and cutscenes
+ New Brawler sprite courtesy of Kodas!
+ New decorations for World 2
+ Added cut in for Final Boss 2
+ You can get costumes for the following: dying 100 times, beating every time trial, beating the game
+ By attacking Clocksworth, you can turn off all upgrades (You can re-enable them by just talking to him)
+ More chest have been added to levels

notes.title: Version 12.1 Patch
notes.content:
A small yet huge update. Here are the notes:

Fixes

o Multiple fixes on save file flags not working correctly
o Fixed an issue where running to the left would act differently than running to the right

Additions

+ World 5-1 and 5-2 are added
+ More cutscenes
+ New added music for levels and cutscenes

Changes

o Some miscellaneous level changes to add more challenge

notes.title: Version 12 Patch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216244/d5eefacf16ee599a0ca46fcb7479b595f9538525.png

Oh yeah. It's all coming together in version 12. Here are the notes:

Fixes

o Fixed double jump upgrade from not working
o Fixed quest 3 from not working

Additions

+ Added gems that come to purify the needle after finishing a boss
+ New cutscene added in the intro
+ Blimps for 4-3 were added
+ New music for 2-2 and 4-3
+ You can play Byte Bashers in the extras menu!
+ Rewatch all cutscenes with thew new gallery option!
+ New Malvas added if you clear quests
+ Parallel 4 added!
+ 2 more malvagato minigames added
+ New achievements added!
+ New music added for Cyberspace Hub and cutscenes

Changes

o Some miscellaneous level changes
o Kai's attacks were more fleshed out
o Reflect buff (Upward 6 -> 7.5///Downward 9->10)
o New Attack Animation for Cappi
o Base Yoyo doesn't go as low anymore
o Changed music for some cutscenes

With this, World 4 is considered completely playable! Only one more world until the game is fully complete! I can't wait for you all to play it!

Until then!
-Snow

notes.title: Version 11.5 Patch
notes.content:
11.5 sounds like the time on a clock, anyways here's the notes:

Fixes

o Fixed a bug where dropping razor after getting hit would make you lose your stored ability as well 
o Fixed the control settings from not lining up with the icons
o Fixes some bugs when restarting after doing certain mechanics or cutscenes
o Currently fixing bug where the world cursor is stuck in a glitched spot when starting a new save file

Additions

+ Added the Void ability! Throw black holes and teleport in the air with this Unfurl power!
+ Added the remaining BG effects for abilities! (These being Frost, Reflect, Void and Wind)
+ 4-3 is playable
+ 4-4 is playable
+ New sprites for Cappi when jumping from a stomp, hitting a spring and walljumping

Changes

o The Reflect Shards that Shine creates can be pulled in with Wind's up attack and Void's black hole
o Mun quotas are lower for every level, meaning that you don't need every mun to get the red star in a level!
o EXPERIMENTAL - Shock's speed boost is no longer on Shock. It is instead a universal mechanic where you go faster depending on how high your combo is (the values determining this are 10, 20, 30, 40 combo)
o EXPERIMENTAL - Shock gives you two mid air jumps instead of three
o Walljumping is faster

notes.title: Version 11.4 Patch
notes.content:
11.4! 11.4! Here's the notes to read up some more:

o Changed the shield sprite animation
+ Added more vertical routes for levels: 4-2 has more changes to fix some level design and add more routes, 3-2 and 2-2 has an additional mini route
+ Added Points Jars! Similar to Shield Jars, they can be found in levels to reward players for seeking them out by giving them points and can help be a boost to getting a higher rank in a level
+ Fixed rollings collision with walls to stop you more consistently and naturally
+ You can boost on grind rails using your tension gauge
+ Changed some transitions

notes.title: Version 11.3 Patch
notes.content:
11.3... 11.3... when thoust you release on steam? Now, actually. Here's the notes:

+ You can crouch
+ After reaching max speed, you can roll on command by pressing down (experimental)
o Several changes to rolling and its values were made to balance it out
+ Shield powerup has a visual sprite now
+ Colorfoams now show on the HUD which on you collected at a certain point in time
+ Atlas and Ruv have secondary attacks when pressing special (Shift on Keyboard) and reaching 200 energy! Defeating or hitting enemies fills this gauge
+ New running sprite for Cappi
+ HP for bosses increased (due to partners having new attacks to use in boss fights)
+ HP increases for harder difficulties increased

+ Shock and Balloon previous nerfs were slightly removed S(4->5) B(5->6) and Shock let's you jump 3 times
+ Fireworks jumps increased (2->4)

+ Quest NPC sprites added
+ Setting to turn off combo stings added
+ More stylistic additions to the UI were added

- Nerfed frequency of getting shield power up as well as limiting the chance of it appearing only to combos above 25
o Drops for items are changed to only appear when a combo is above 3 (healing) or 5 (malva puff)

+ Actually fixed the time issue

- Nerfed mid air attack invuln frames (34-14) as HALF A SECOND for an attack you can do every 2/3 a second was a bit much

+ Improved the dialogue box by adding animations and changing the blip sound

+ Resized dash attack sprite

notes.title: Version 11.1 Patch
notes.content:
111111111111111111111111111111. Small patch to fix some issues:

o Timer no longer appears during end cutscenes
- Firework jumps are limited to 2 now
+ Fixed quest NPC from showing in 3-3 when not doing the quest
+ Fixed bosses being able to be hit before initiating the fight
+ Fixed minecart not setting you forward
- Firework jump sends you less upward (6 -> 4)
+ Fixed clothes UI from showing the wrong colored disabled hoodies for some slots
- Shock mid air jump sends you less upward (7 -> 4)
- Balloon sends you less upward (7 -> 5)
+ Fixed issue of instant killing enemies or flying up in the air when jumping on them
+ Sounds damage values fixed
o Restarting in 3-2 properly stops all music
+ Fixed names for electric and balloon thrones not appearing
+ Fixed visual bug with Mirror Crash
+ Fixed Frost from not slashing until near fully charged
- Mirror Crash upward velocity is nerfed (7 -> 6)
- Mirror Crash downward velocity is nerfed (14 -> 9)
- Invulnerability for Mirror Crash is nerfed (40->30)

notes.title: Version 11 Patch
notes.content:
The big 1 on 1, Many big changes listed here:

o Level changes: quite a few levels have a new alternate routes for more ways to play a level. Some routes provide more points for higher scores while other routes are good for meeting the mun requirement or some routes can have special collectibles. Additionally, more enemies were placed in areas that were empty to fill each level with more content.
o Timer is now in every level. Kind of surprising it took a year and a half to do this but don't question my genius
- Abilites now despawn when they drop
+ Many new sound effects to improve the juice of the game
+ Fixed C Train Achievement from not triggering
+ Fixed sprite of dead Sharp Cutters using the wrong one
+ Stylish new combo UI

Malva Garden
+ Sound effects for Malvas leveling up
+ Level cap raised to 25
+ First minigame added

Quests
+ Adds a questing "system" where you can do challenges for bonus rewards such as more malvagatos and reports

o Quests and time trials default your ability to Normal 

+ 4-1 and 4-2 are playable

notes.title: Version 10.5 Patch
notes.content:
10.5, right on time, here's some "small" changes:

o You can dash attack out of a landing dash now (if you don't know what a landing dash is, this is performed by pressing discard while landing from a stomp)
o By holding attack during Rolling's down attack, you will continue rolling at that same speed until you let go
o You can jump out of Rolling's down attack
o Now if you hold a direction and perform an air dash, you can automatically swap your velocity in either right or left without needing to change momentum
o You can jump out of Ruv's attack
+ Fixed upgrades UI for not displaying properly if you had the exact number for an upgrade
+ Actual sprite for when Cappi interacts with the Clothes Closet or Clocksworth
+ Fixed Frost not working
+ More feedback! Added a lot more sound effects to different things that had none to make everything more clean

notes.title: Version 10.4
notes.content:
10.4, back for more, here's a few changes:

o Isabella's attacks are wind based to clearly show she uses Force, this also affects the hitboxes for two of her attacks
o Title Screen slightly altered
+ A few projectiles that couldn't be parried can now be parried, namely Simon's 4th attack, ???'s 3rd attack and the stalactite in Brawler's fight
o Reworked how spikes and pits collisions worked, should now work properly and fairly
+ New cutscenes for 1-4, 2-4, 3-4
o Player UI is updated to show the name of ability as well as the kind of affinity the element uses
+ Fixed an issue where getting the abilities from the thrones were not consistent like getting them traditionally
+ Simon attack changes in desperate mode were added
+ No longer a cooldown to parry Brawler
+ Added new attack for Seraphina
+ New enemies were added
- Can't cheese Isabella with Ruv anymore
o Buffed major boss HP
+ Bomb can be used in the air without halting momentum

notes.title: Version 10.3 Patch
notes.content:
Thanks to *fascinating* testing by a player of mine, we got some new patches for the game coming out! These will be general improvements to some aspects that I think will make the game more expressible:

+ Parry can be done in the air now
+ Successful parries will have a faster cooldown
+ Aerial attacks now have more invulnerability (12->34 frames)
+ Dying no longer removes the ability you had
- Pyros midair attack will destroy on contact with an enemy
o Rolling can be triggered at anytime instead of when not running
+ Increased Ruv recovery (0.7 -> 1.3)
+ Increased Atlas recovery (1.5 -> 2.5)
o Fixed a mun that was stuck in the tree (how did it get there)
o Added proper backgrounds to 3-2


o Level 4-1 is playable but unavailable currenntly

notes.title: Version 10.2 Patch
notes.content:
Small changes to fix some issues:

-You can no longer use invulnerability frames to cheese a bottomless pit. They now operate through a timer on collision
-Upgrade Menu fixes one crash and no longer shows you the text on upgraded slots if you press confirm on it again
-Mouse button icons are made so you can now rebind to mouse safely

notes.title: Version 10.1 Patch
notes.content:
Small patches for the steam release that weren't in version 10. Make sure to update the game!

-Fixed a softlock issue in 2-2 when colliding with enemies on the minecart
-Enemies will flash before shooting projectiles
-Bosses have two colors for attack flashing: red for an attack that can be parred and purple for an attack that can't be parried.
-You can use your yoyo to destroy the Oasisian Child's sand castle
-Spikes are tinted purple to stand out a bit more as a threat
-Knockback is reduced (6->4)
-Razor no longer spins you out when dash attacking
